records.leaf_name: Basic Engineering Science and Dimensional Reasoning
allowed_scope: frequency and period interpretation for a stated periodic process
magnitude and phase interpretation of supplied ideal series resistance and inductive reactance
excluded_scope: general chemistry not represented in the allowed subset
specialist electrical design and component selection
limitations: Author only within the narrow physical-quantity families supported by the linked OpenStax physics and NIST material; do not treat this leaf as a catch-all science category.
The detailed public PRC TOS is Resolution 57 (2013); the 2026 MELE program names only the Mathematics area and does not restate detailed subareas.
records.readiness_reason: A source-traceable, bounded physics/dimensional subset is now covered by the linked study material; chemistry and broader physics remain outside the allowed scope.

allowed_scope: generic bearing/lubrication principles covered by existing material
excluded_scope: manufacturer-specific bearing ratings and current lubricant specifications
limitations: Use rating/duty assumptions supplied by the problem; no vendor-specific life claim.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

allowed_scope: foundational drawing interpretation, views/projections, sections, and dimensioning taught in linked course material
excluded_scope: current ISO/ASME drafting-standard conformity, manufacturing tolerances, and code-specific drawing requirements not covered by linked material
limitations: PRC Resolution 57 (2013) names Engineering Drawing Practices at 2.27; no replacement detailed TOS was located. NPTEL material supports foundational practice only, not current standards compliance.
records.readiness_reason: The previously authorized distinct content headroom has been consumed by Batch 647; no further authoring is permitted until new source-supported families justify renewed headroom.
records.review_reason: Current evidence-bounded headroom is exhausted after Batch 647 additions; review only if new distinct, source-supported content becomes available.

allowed_scope: fundamental economic comparison stated with complete assumptions
excluded_scope: tax, accounting, contract, or jurisdiction-specific rules not sourced for the current exam
limitations: Use the exact economic competencies in Resolution 57 (2013), which PRC states applies to subsequent MELEs; do not infer newer regulatory or accounting content.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

allowed_scope: fundamental mechanics and kinematics with stated system boundaries
limitations: The current TOS explicitly names kinematic analysis in the machine-design paper; mechanics beyond it is BoardPrep-derived.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

records.leaf_name: Pumps, Compressors, Fans, and Fluid Machinery
allowed_scope: basic machinery performance supported by current linked technical material
excluded_scope: code-based equipment sizing, pressure-vessel design, and vendor guarantees
limitations: Pump and compressor calculations must retain stated operating assumptions and efficiency definitions.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

allowed_scope: elementary fluid mechanics bounded to the current PRC Mathematics TOS and stated assumptions
excluded_scope: broad fluid specialization, machinery selection, and unsourced codes/standards
limitations: PRC states the detailed TOS applies to subsequent MELEs; use this leaf for Mathematics-paper fluid mechanics, not pump/compressor selection.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

excluded_scope: current emissions, fuel, and grid-code requirements
limitations: Restrict claims to supplied cycle/component assumptions.
records.readiness_reason: The previously authorized distinct content headroom has been consumed by Batch 647; no further authoring is permitted until new source-supported families justify renewed headroom.
records.review_reason: Current evidence-bounded headroom is exhausted after Batch 647 additions; review only if new distinct, source-supported content becomes available.

allowed_scope: classical heat-transfer principles and stated heat-exchanger calculations
excluded_scope: current pressure-equipment design codes and vendor-specific guarantees
limitations: Material-property data and current equipment standards must be verified when itemized.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

records.leaf_name: Refrigeration, Air Conditioning, and Psychrometric Loads
allowed_scope: stable refrigeration-cycle and basic HVAC technical principles are study-supported but not authorable until direct MELE scope is confirmed
excluded_scope: all new HVAC/refrigeration question authoring pending direct MELE scope confirmation
refrigerant restrictions, current HVAC codes, fire/life-safety requirements, and specialty certification
limitations: R.A. 8495 defines HVAC/refrigeration equipment and professional practice, but that does not establish MELE exam scope.
The 2024 Certified Plant Mechanic HVAC TOS and 2025 advanced-PME HVAC specialization are different examination/credential regimes and are not used as MELE scope evidence.
The 2026 MELE program does not name HVAC; the publicly located detailed TOS has no explicit HVAC subarea crosswalk for this leaf.
records.readiness_reason: Technical study support is sufficient for stable HVAC principles, but the official MELE scope linkage remains materially unresolved.
records.review_reason: No direct current PRC MELE scope confirmation was found for this BoardPrep-derived HVAC leaf. The professional-practice definition and separate CPM/advanced-PME scope documents cannot substitute for MELE exam-scope evidence.

allowed_scope: basic hydraulic power and plant-energy relationships
excluded_scope: dam safety, water rights, and current environmental permitting
limitations: Existing study material covers energy and fluid principles but is not a hydroelectric-plant design manual.
records.readiness_reason: The previously authorized distinct content headroom has been consumed by Batch 647; no further authoring is permitted until new source-supported families justify renewed headroom.
records.review_reason: Current evidence-bounded headroom is exhausted after Batch 647 additions; review only if new distinct, source-supported content becomes available.

excluded_scope: emissions compliance and current engine certification
limitations: Emission and fuel-quality requirements are not covered by the linked study sources.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

records.leaf_name: Machine-Design Stress Analysis and Combined Loading
allowed_scope: bounded design stress analysis and combined-load calculations in the published Machine Design TOS
excluded_scope: current code allowables, certified design, and unsourced safety factors
limitations: Use only stated loads, geometry, material values, and criteria; this is not a professional design approval.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

records.leaf_name: Machine Elements and Mechanical Power Transmission
allowed_scope: fundamental machine-element relationships and stated component models
excluded_scope: unsourced design standards, proprietary ratings, and code-certified component design
limitations: Do not conflate power transmission ratios with fatigue, lubrication, or bearing-life assessment.
records.readiness_reason: Authoring is bounded to the explicit PRC crosswalk and source-supported study scope recorded for this leaf.

allowed_scope: fundamental manufacturing processes and calculations represented by the open textbook
excluded_scope: current machine safety code, regulated welding certification, and machine-specific procedures

allowed_scope: general materials behavior and explicitly supplied material properties
excluded_scope: current alloy specifications, heat-treatment schedules, and certification requirements not sourced

allowed_scope: elementary algebra and plane trigonometry within the public PRC TOS
